en:
Rokuro: It was lying on
the back hill, so I
picked it up. It is no use to me, so
you have it.

Innkeeper: Keyaki will
come back, I am sure. Laughing brightly, as
if nothing had
happened.

Innkeeper: Keyaki will
come back, I am sure. Laughing brightly, as
if nothing had
happened.

Koppa: Come to think of
it, I understand
animals. Let us talk to the ones
in the village.

Nagi: Fumi, are you
hurt? It must have been
awful... But I am glad. Glad you
are safe...

Innkeeper: Honestly, are
there no men at all in
this village! Spineless, the lot of
you!

Kinji: Gran. Building
that Warehouse has made
me hungry again. Have we anything to
eat?

Nagi: Hmph! Go back on
your own. I will do it
by myself. M-monsters do not scare
me...

Koppa: That Kinji... he
did it on purpose. To make Keyaki say how
she really feels...

Yoshizota: They say
Orochi is a tough one, but I reckon you can
manage it. Good luck!

Masa: If you cannot save
Nagi, no one will blame
you. You are an outsider,
after all.

Innkeeper: Kinji came by
just now. He has something to
tell , so come to
the shrine.

Rooster: Gakk, cluck
cluck... (Urgh. Even I must run
out of strength at
last...)

Koppa: Brrr... What a
frightening place that
was. Let us get home, and
quickly.

Old Seer: Orochi dwells
at Kuyo Pass. Together with the
monsters that serve it.

Tanmomo: Meow! (I am a cat of the
first order. Tanmomo?
What a silly name!)

Kinji: Are you all right
after that fit?... You still look to be in
pain.

Innkeeper: Back again? You must be very fond
of this village...

Kinji: You usually talk
more than this... You are like
today.

Rooster: Cock-a-doo!
Cock-a-doo! ( is
small fry! Bring me
Orochi!)

Koppa: Keyaki said she
would wait at the
shrine... What do we do?

Fumi: ...Big brother... I... my heart is still
pounding...

Yoshizota: I have taken
a liking to you. Let us drink again some
time!

Chief: Thank you. I never thought to see
Nagi alive again...

Masa: You... you are not
bad at all. I have changed my view
of you.

Kinji: That is my
supper, mind. Do not tell the others.

Old Seer: You have only
just eaten! You will wait until
supper.

Kinji: Keyaki is lovely,
is she not... I... I...

Masa: Just because
Keyaki is kind to you, do not go getting
ideas.

Innkeeper: Keyaki still
has not come back. Whatever can have
happened.

Fumi's Mom: Forgive me,
this is all I can do. But please, Fumi...

Old Seer: At a time like
this, is one not usually
unable to eat a thing?

Innkeeper: Ah, you woke
up at last! You were crying out so
terribly in your sleep.
I was worried sick. Where are you? Why,
this is Moonlight
Village, dear. You were set upon by
monsters up at Kuyo
Pass, were you not? If your strength runs
out up there, you get
thrown out down here. Anyway, you ought to go
and thank Keyaki. She has been nursing
you this whole time.

Nagi: Big brother! I
want to come too after
all! I am coming with you!
No is not an answer! ...Or so I thought, but
I suddenly need the
toilet. Go on ahead! ...Or so I thought, but
now it will not come. Hmm. What do I do?

Chief: What! The scroll
is gone! It was certainly there
until yesterday... Someone said they saw a
figure last night, heading for Dragonmaw. They took not the Easy
road but Normal or
Hard, it seems. Why not go by Normal or
Hard yourselves? Something may come of
it... Forgive me... that was
a most irresponsible
thing to say...

Nagi: Waaah! Wh-what...
oh, not a monster. You
gave me a fright. ...Eh? You came to
rescue me? No! I am not going
back! Though I would go if
you promised to save
Fumi...

Yoshizota: My name is
Yoshizota. I travel the country
selling medicine. I stop by this village
now and then. Say. You will be off to
save Fumi after this, I
suppose?

Gon: Wh-what, Koppa is a
weasel?! Then I have
seen him. A few days before you
came. A weasel that smelled
fit to knock you down
walked past me. Only the once, mind.
But the way he was
headed... that was towards Kuyo
Pass. Uuungh.

Masa: Ah, . Kinji and I extended
the Warehouse
yesterday. Now it holds a good
many more items. Remember you can only
take 5 items
adventuring, and Pots lose their
contents. Do take care.

Masa: Beyond here is
what they call Kuyo
Pass. A terribly dangerous
place. If you must go, call at
the shrine first. The Shrine Priest will
tell you all sorts. Also, Kuyo Pass splits
into three roads. Look at the map on that
signboard and you can
choose.

Rokuro: Look, if a man
wants to go, why force
him to stay? Let him go. Well, it is easy for an
outsider. Even if the monsters
get him, he only gets
sent back here... Not like us...

Old Seer: Some 15 floors
from Moonlight Village lies the place they
call Dragonmaw. Orochi is a further 6
floors on. Some 21 floors from the
village, they say. ...As to why I tell you
this, I have begun to feel
you might do something
about it...

Innkeeper: Good morning.
You slept very soundly. You must have been
quite worn out. By the way, you have a
visitor. He said to call him
when you woke. That man
over there.

Rokuro: You... why do
you keep doing this? There is nothing in it
for you. ...Well. If you will
go, I will not stop
you. But I will tell you one
thing. Kuyo Pass splits into
three roads. Look at the map on that
signboard and you can
choose.

Masa: N-not me, I will
not... Grandson of the Village
Chief or no, I am not going up
there!

Kinji: Chomp chomp chomp
chomp! Chomp chomp chomp
chomp!! Chomp chomp chomp chomp
chomp!!!

Chief: W-wait! Do not be
alarmed! It is me. The village
chief. I look like this, but
my reason is my own. I will not harm you. Come closer and hear me
out.

Masa: Hey, ! This
is the last job I can
do. I have widened the
Warehouse as far as it
will go. Well, that is the limit
of it. You can still only take
5 items adventuring, and a Pot loses its
contents if you carry
it... The rest is up to you,
! It is down to your own
arm. We are counting on
you!

Old Seer: Destiny, fate,
custom... All of them are about
to be overturned. Orochi is formidable,
true... but I feel a brighter
light still in you.

Nagi: Right! I will go
back. Do not forget
your promise. ...Truth is, I was
scared out of my wits. So, er... ...I badly need the
toilet. Let us hurry home.

Keyaki: Here, take this!
They call it an ID
Bracer. Terribly useful, they
say... Eh? You cannot take it with
you?! Oh... what a shame. Cheering you on is all
I can do... Good luck!

Innkeeper: You mean
Keyaki? Oh, stop that.
She is not my girl. I am still single, I
will have you know. She drifts in here now
and then and helps out
around the place. She is an odd one in
her way, but a good
girl. That child is...

Nagi: The other day an
odd shield was lying by
the river, but I needed the toilet
so I came home without
it. I will fetch it next
time.

Chief: Madness! He will
be monster fodder and
nothing more! He cannot have got far
yet! Go after him now and
you should be in
time...

Rokuro: Truth is, I have
something to give you,
... But , you are
carrying 5 items or
more, so I cannot hand it
over. Never mind...

Fumi's Mom: I am laying
out bedding for . If you are tired, do
rest here. Now, once this is done
I must go and help the
Innkeeper!

Innkeeper: Knocked down,
and back up again, over
and over... You are the man I took
you for, and no
mistake. Good luck out there!

Innkeeper: Oh my, a
customer? Eh, no? What a shame.
We so rarely get
visitors from outside. Frankly I am bored out
of my wits...

Masa: Store your things
in the Warehouse. It would be a shame to
lose them. That Warehouse is
yours. Use it freely
from now on.

Old Seer: For the first
time, hope is being
born in the villagers. Thanks to you, light is
beginning to reach this
village too.

Masa: Items left in the
Warehouse are not lost
if you fall. Mind you, everything
inside a Pot vanishes.
Be careful. And you can only take 5
items with you. Pots lose their
contents, remember.

Masa: Items left in the
Warehouse are not lost
if you fall. Mind you, everything
inside a Pot vanishes.
Be careful. And you can only take 5
items with you. Pots lose their
contents, remember.

Innkeeper: Keyaki? She
looked to be headed for
the shrine... A whimsical thing. Now
and then she drifts off
somewhere. Like a cat. Not that I am busy,
mind. There are no
customers either.

Nagi: Thank you, big
brother. When I saw Fumi's face
again I was just... so
happy. Fumi seems a lot calmer
now too.

Keyaki: Ah... are you a
traveller? If it is lodging you
want, it is just down
from here. A place called the
Totoya.

Keyaki: No. I found her
behind the shrine a
little while ago. She was freezing, poor
thing... Do be good to her!

Rokuro: There is no
happier news! Tonight
we feast! Oh, no need to worry.
It should be cloudy
tonight. So we likely will not
change. Come, everyone! Gather
round and let us
make merry!

Keyaki: The thing is, I
would like you to look
after this cat a while. Her name is Tanmomo. Do
be good to her!

Koppa: ...And so, hic. Right then I thought,
is in danger! So I ran Yoshizota
through with my sword,
shff...

Gon: Whenever the Shrine
Priest looks set to
scold me, I use this to run off. Uuungh. Comes in right
handy.

Chief: Oho, what is the
matter? What? You cannot leave
Moonlight Village? Hmmm. Strange things do
happen...

Rokuro: If the monsters
get him up there, that
is the end. He never comes back. We can only give him
up.

Gon: Uuungh. No, I have
not seen him. This Koppa fellow. Gone off to another
village, has he not?

Masa: Oi, Kinji! Stop
stuffing your face and help with the work! We still have things
left to do!

Chief: N-Nagi? ...Is it
hopeless after all. On a child's legs, he
must be some 10 floors
on by now... The monsters
thereabouts are
fearsome... Oh, I am so worried...

Masa: Eh? Build you a
house next time you
come? Did I say that? W-well. One of these
days...

Kinji: Oh, there you
are! Come with me a
moment, . There is something I
want to show you.

Tagura: Last night, you
mean? I always sleep soundly.
I do have strange
dreams, though...

Yoshizota: They say you
came back from Kuyo
Pass? That is something.
Here, have a drink.

Keyaki: Look how short
her thighs are. And so, Tanmomo.
Short-thigh. Do be good to her!

Rokuro: Tch! Sent back,
were you! No good after
all! Going up there is a
waste of time.

Nagi: It will be all
right, missus. This fellow here will
save her, I know it!
Right!

Innkeeper: Tonight is on
me, so drink your fill! ...Though, now I look,
you are loaded down
with baggage. You cannot relax like
that. Best put your precious
things in the
Warehouse. It would not do to get
drunk and lose them...

Gon: Uuungh. That smelly
weasel the other day. So he was a friend of
yours. Uuungh.

Masa: This ought to make
your adventuring a good
deal easier. Good luck with Fumi!

Gon: Koppa? Never heard
of him. Uuungh. Were you meant
to meet up in this
village?

Keyaki: Lately the
villagers seem to have
accepted you, . It makes me so happy...

Keyaki: Are you all
right? ...Oh, good. All I could think of
was your wounds,
...

Koppa: Hey , over
there! Eh? Keyaki is there
too. Looks like they
are talking.

Nagi: Eh? You lot... I know! You were about
to wet yourself and
turned back!

Kinji: We must build it
quickly! But I am hungry and
have no strength in me.

Old Seer: Hm? What is
it? Ah! Surely not... you
have come to see me...
ooh.

Masa: Oh, it is you! ...Sorry. We are in the
middle of something
important.

Rokuro: Nagi! Nagi is
gone! I have looked
everywhere and cannot
find him!!

Yoshizota: An unsettled
land, where all manner
of things happen... I came here to take the
power of this earth for
my own. What if I had the
village drink this drug
of mine? They turn to monsters
and can never turn
back. And they obey no one
but me. It does not work on
grown-ups. Hence the
child sacrifices. So close... I was so
close to finishing this
cave, too... Why do you try to save
them? For a village of
monsters! You would strike down a
human being, to save
monsters? ............ I have
another drug here. Made from the life
blood of the children,
a little at a time. What happens when a
human drinks it? Let me
show you!

Keyaki: Hm? What was I
praying for? ...Hee hee. That is a
secret.

Nagi: ............ Waaaaaaah!! This place
is scaaary after all!!

Nagi: Ah, you came! Let us hurry back. I am
still holding it in.

Chief: Moonlight falls
upon us, and we change
shape. It is in the blood of
our line. Beyond the sea they
call our kind vampires,
I believe. It is why we live
hidden, where no eye
falls on us. Orochi... the
sacrifices... Kuyo
Pass... Forgive me. Of those I
cannot speak. Even this much likely
reaches Orochi's
ears... Beneath the offering
box at the shrine lies
a scroll. Read it, and Dragonmaw
should open. , I beg you! Save
Fumi! Save her, and the
custom of sacrifice is
broken. Deliver Fumi from the
cursed fate of this
village!

Gon: That thing there is
Koppa? Uuungh. Smells about
right...

Innkeeper: This is
Moonlight Village. Did you not leave this
place?

Priest: What! You cannot
leave the village! Hmm. I always give counsel
to those who travel the
dungeons. What would you ask of
me? ...Or so I would say.
But this one is beyond
me too.

Fumi's Mom: Ah, . You did so much for us
then... Thank you,
truly.

Masa: Eh? If it is not
. What on earth is the
matter...

Chief: Still cannot get
out! Hmm. Strange things do
happen...

Nagi: Again? Holding it in that long
is bad for you.

Gon: Wa-ha-ha-haaa! You are quite the
joker, you are!

Fumi's Mom: Custom or
no... why does it have to be
my daughter...

Kinji: It is hard on him
too. He was closer to Fumi
than anyone.

Rokuro: Surely not...
no, there is no
mistake! He has gone to save
Fumi!

Chief: What? Yoshizota? Th-that man is in the
village?!

Keyaki: So now it is
Fumi's turn at last. Here, take this!

Keyaki: So Kinji is
cheering you on too... That makes me happy.

Masa: ...... I-I am all right. It is
finally settling.

Kinji: They say Keyaki
has gone? Waaaaaaah!

Gon: Where can Keyaki
have gone? Uuungh. And I had my
eye on her too.

Kinji: I think Keyaki
has feelings for
... Ugh, I am so jealous...

Kinji: Gran, I have been
jilted. Food...

Kinji: ...Keyakiii.
Waaah. Chomp chomp chomp
chomp!
